map.由每股净资产与股价求账面市值比: Compute the Book-to-Market Ratio from Book Value per Share and Price
map.输入每股净资产 BVPS 与股价 P，求账面市值比。: Enter the book value per share (BVPS) and the price P to obtain the book-to-market ratio.
map.📖 查看「由每股净资产与股价求账面市值比 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compute the Book-to-Market Ratio from Book Value per Share and Price User Guide"
map.市净率的倒数，价值股常偏高。: The reciprocal of the price-to-book ratio; often high for value stocks.
map.价值投资策略筛选（低 P/B = 高 B/M 多为价值股）。: Value-investing screens (a low P/B = a high B/M, usually a value stock).
map.Fama-French 三因子中 HML（价值因子）的构建。: Construction of HML (the value factor) in the Fama-French three-factor model.
map.判断公司被低估还是高估的粗略指标。: A rough indicator of whether a company is undervalued or overvalued.
map.B/M = 账面价值/市值 = 10/25 = 0.40。B/M<1 表示市值高: B/M = book value / market value = 10/25 = 0.40. B/M < 1 means the market value exceeds book value, implying stronger growth expectations; value stocks usually have a B/M close to or above 1.
map.B/M = 8/6 ≈ 1.33。B/M>1 表示市值低于净资产，偏深度价值（需: B/M = 8/6 ≈ 1.33. B/M > 1 means the market value is below net assets, leaning deep value (watch out for asset-quality traps).
map.B/M 和 P/B 的关系？: How are B/M and P/B related?
map.互为倒数：P/B = 1/(B/M)。P/B<1 ⇔ B/M>1（市值低于账面）: They are reciprocals: P/B = 1/(B/M). P/B < 1 ⇔ B/M > 1 (market value below book value).
map.B/M 高一定便宜吗？: Does a high B/M always mean cheap?
map.不一定。账面价值可能含商誉、存货减值风险，或行业已衰退。需结合 ROE、资产质量: Not necessarily. Book value may include goodwill or inventory-impairment risk, or the industry may have declined. Judge it together with ROE and asset quality to avoid a "value trap".
